newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B index consolidates after recent gains.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B index consolidates after recent gains.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index inched down on Wednesday as investors held back following recent sharp rises, analysts said.
The foreign currency B index lost 1.30 points or 0.73 percent to 177.09 with turnover shrinking to HK$135.4 million from HK$199.4 million on Tuesday.
"Foreign investors seemed to be alarmed by last week's sharp rises and have adopted a wait-and-see attitude," an analyst at China Southern Securities said.
The index hit year-highs for three straight sessions by Monday's close, and began a technical correction on Tuesday, analysts said.
"The index will probably continue the correction until the end of the week, but the market mood should not be hurt," an analyst at J&A Securities said.
